owner: RI-CAM03 §D — `size_bias(h) = 2.20 × max(0, h − 2.5)` and `k(h) = clamp((h − 2.5)/4, 0, 0.75)` are functions of the target's COLLISION HEIGHT, so the height has to be declared per archetype rather than guessed from a radius.
note: Heights in metres, floor to the topmost tell-bearing node. The worked table in RI-CAM03 §D uses 0.6 (marsh rat), 1.9 (naga levy / INFANTRY), 2.6 (elite), 4.5 (mid boss) and 8.0 (great boss); those five rows are what RI-CAM03 M2's 40-pose sweep needs, and they are the five `cam_*` dummies below.
